remaining_concerns: The admissible record still shows a 2.1 percentage point miss in Spanish-language billing support for a segment named in three international pilot commitments, so materiality remains live under the stated policy.
The policy predicate is still unresolved because there is no admissible evidence of required disclosure, resolution of the limitation, or approved risk acceptance before launch.
Legal review is still open on whether the gap must be disclosed, and that pending determination remains outcome-determinative under the policy and policy text provided.

Aggregate readiness and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents still do not satisfy the separate disclosure or risk-acceptance requirement for a material limitation affecting a named launch use case.

Public model-card and risk-management guidance still support documentation and monitoring only at a general level and do not cure the missing internal policy support for certification on the present record.

Product's non-core framing still does not resolve materiality because the record does not negate the named pilot commitments and the policy text says such labels do not control when legal review is pending or customer commitments are implicated.
final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim using the same record. That narrowing is useful as characterization: it distinguishes a caveated certification narrative from an overbroad clean-compliance claim. But it does not close the audit concerns that drove the initial report. The admissible evidence still shows a material performance gap in a named pilot segment, an open legal disclosure question, and no approved risk acceptance or final disclosure artifact. Under the stated policy, those unresolved predicates prevent treating certification as supported compliance. A more caveated packet may reduce overstatement risk in the packet itself, but it does not make the underlying certification position compliant or compliant_with_caveats on the current record.
